verdicts.reason: A: the headline gets strong, readable hierarchy, but the SOLSTICE logo has shrunk to an illegible speck. The NEW FLAVOR badge is blown up to button size and sits right above the CTA, so it reads as a second, competing call to action. The CTA pill nearly touches the canvas edges. B: keeps the original reading order, but the NEW FLAVOR pill is jammed into the top-left corner and looks clipped. The logo wordmark is faint and tiny, the headline and body copy are undersized for the column, and the bottom quarter is dead space, so the layout is lopsided.
